Mane N Minks Vet Spa & Pet Hotel in Houston is hands-down the BEST decision I’ve ever made for my dog. From the moment I dropped them off, I felt completely at ease knowing my baby was in loving, professional hands.

They literally gave ALL the works — grooming, pampering, attention, and top-tier care like my dog was royalty. When I picked them up, they were clean, relaxed, happy, and smelling AMAZING. You can tell this place doesn’t just “watch” pets — they genuinely care for them.

The staff was incredibly kind, communicative, and attentive, and the facility itself is clean, calm, and well-run. My dog came back looking and feeling better than when I dropped them off, which says everything.

If you’re looking for a vet spa and pet hotel where your fur baby will be treated like family, this is the place. I wouldn’t trust anyone else in Houston with my dog. Highly, highly recommend! 🐶💖✨

Yesterday, I took my dog to Mane and Minks for a grooming appointment scheduled at 12:00 pm, expecting it to last 2½ hours. However, when I went to pick him up at 4:00 pm, realizing they hadn't called, I found out they still hadn't finished. Despite being fully booked and dealing with another pet emergency, they hadn't managed to complete the grooming. One of the groomers was particularly rude and disrespectful. On a previous visit, they even called me to say my dog was misbehaving during the grooming, but when I rushed there, it turned out to be a case of mistaken identity. Despite the location's convenience, I won't be returning due to this experience. Moreover, I doubt everything was done properly during the five hours my dog was there, as he was still covered in hair when I picked him up, suggesting they might not have even bathed him.
